title: Director of Global Quality
text:
**About Momentive Technologies**

Momentive Technologies applies advanced materials science to design and manufacture ultra-high-performance quartz materials, quartz crucibles, and ceramic products that are vital to a variety of high-growth end markets, including the silicon and compound semiconductor industries, electronics, and aerospace components. These solutions enable the production of logic and memory chips, power control devices and multiple systems for electric vehicles, integrated circuits, power control devices, data servers, and aerospace applications.

Recognized for the purity, performance, consistency and stability of its products, Momentive Technologies has been delivering innovative solutions for over 130 years and continues to impact emerging trends like electrification, digitalization, renewable energy and artificial intelligence. The Company, headquartered in Strongsville, Ohio, has operations across the globe and serves customers in more than 30 countries. For more information, visit
www.momentivetech.com

**Director Global Quality**

The Director, Global Quality is a highly visible leadership role responsible for shaping and advancing quality strategy across our global organization. Serving as a trusted advisor to the Executive Leadership Team, this individual will provide insight into quality performance, requirements, risks, and opportunities while driving greater consistency and excellence across operations in the United States, Germany, South Korea, China, and Japan.

This leader will champion continuous improvement, strengthen quality systems and processes, and identify opportunities to enhance both operational performance and customer satisfaction. Equally important, the Director will lead, mentor, and develop quality leaders across the regions, creating an engaged, accountable, and collaborative global Quality organization.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and lead the global Quality and QMS strategy, establishing standardized processes, governance, performance expectations, and accountability across global sites and product lines while ensuring compliance with ISO 9001, customer-specific, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Establish global quality standards and drive QMS harmonization, reducing unnecessary site-to-site variation and deploying common approaches for CAPA, nonconformance, change management, risk management, audits, document control, and management review.
* Lead global quality performance and continuous improvement, using quality trends, COPQ, yield, customer complaints, escapes, and systemic risk to prioritize improvement initiatives, allocate resources, and deliver sustainable improvement in quality and business performance.
* Own the global strategy for supplier and critical material quality, establishing standards for supplier qualification, onboarding, performance management, auditing, corrective action, and development to strengthen supplier capability and reduce risk to product quality and supply continuity.
* Provide leadership for significant customer, supplier, and product quality escalations, ensuring effective containment, root-cause investigation, corrective action, and systemic prevention while protecting customer relationships and business continuity.
* Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Technology, and Commercial leadership to integrate quality requirements and risk management into sourcing decisions, manufacturing strategy, new products, process changes, and capacity expansion.
* Build global quality capability and organizational effectiveness, coaching Quality Leaders, facilitating deployment of best practices across sites and product lines, and strengthening technical competency, problem-solving discipline, training, talent development, and succession planning.
* Monitor emerging customer expectations, industry requirements, technologies, and external quality practices, translating relevant developments into the global quality strategy, QMS, supplier quality approach, and continuous improvement priorities.

**Basic Qualifications**

* A minimum of 10 years’ of experience in Quality Assurance or similar Quality role.
* 5+ years Leadership Experience directing a Professional Team, preferably on a global level.
* Strong proficiency in ISO 9001 and AS 9100 quality standards
* Outstanding organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage many projects or programs simultaneously.
* Possess a communication style that builds strong relationships at all levels of the organization and impacts outcomes and decisions.
* Demonstrated strong analytical expertise coupled with effective presentation, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.
* Possess transformational leadership qualities – ability to engage, inspire, challenge and influence others and without formal authority.
* Experience in working with ERP systems, preferably SAP.
* Strong knowledge of problem solving and analytical tools such as 8-D, RCCA, SPC or similar
* Experience in industrial manufacturing, preferably chemical industry or glass industry

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience leading a global quality organization
* Expert knowledge of SAP QM functional module
* Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt Certification
* ISO9001 and AS9001 internal auditor or lead auditor certifications

**Travel Requirements:**

* 15-20%

**Total Rewards**

Our
**Director Global Quality**
will earn a variable compensation including base salary and bonus. Base salary range takes into consideration experience, education, and training. Not to mention all the amazing benefits available for employee selection as well.

* 401(k) plan with Company Match

Momentive Technologies is not just shaping materials; we're shaping the future. As a leader in the fused quartz, ceramics, and crucibles industry, we pride ourselves on innovation, precision, and excellence. When you join us, you'll be part of a dynamic team that's driving advancements in technology, research, and applications across various sectors.
**APPLY NOW!**

**EEO Statement**

We treat all our associates and candidates as equals. We require all associates and managers to do so too and comply with employment laws and regulations. All personnel actions are conducted in the spirit of equal employment. We are committed to recruit, train, promote and retain associates without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identification and expression, national origin, marital status, age, disability, genetic information, military status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.

**Accessibility Guidelines**

We are committed to making the on-line application experience easy and accessible to individuals with disabilities. We are constantly making improvements to comply with the spirit of the "Americans with Disabilities Act," and the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines. If any of the information on the website is not accessible to you due to a disability, please contact us via phone at (440) 878-5739. Please provide the location of the inaccessible information and the format you wish to have the information presented and we will be happy to send it to you, either via your email address or a separate mailing address you provide. If you prefer, you may contact us and we will be happy to assist you with the application process.
